end.summary:
Defined food miles as the distance food travels from farm to plate.
Compared apples from Shimla with spinach from a nearby Delhi farm.
Identified greater food miles with more transport distance and petrol use.
Noted that the route should include the farm, shop, and home.
Teach-back was not completed successfully.
end.parentNote: Rohan practised defining food miles and comparing foods from nearby and distant places. They used the farm-to-plate route and connected longer journeys with more petrol; they also noticed when a picture left out the farm-to-shop section. At home, ask them to trace one food’s journey from farm to plate and name which part adds distance.
